# Setup
```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(sf)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
library(viridis)
library(patchwork)

# Make ggplot output consistent
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  dpi = 150
)
```


# Data Loading
```{r}
# 1. Read the stations file
stations <- read_csv("data/stations.csv") %>%
  mutate(id = as.character(id))

# 2. Read all 18 yearly files into one long tibble
years <- 2001:2018

read_year <- function(yr) {
  read_csv(
    paste0("data/madrid_", yr, ".csv"),
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    progress = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(station = as.character(station)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -c(date, station),
      names_to = "pollutant",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value))
}

raw <- map_dfr(years, read_year)

# 3. Add date components
raw <- raw %>%
  mutate(
    date  = as_datetime(date),
    year  = year(date),
    month = month(date)
  )

# 4. Keep only the five pollutants used in the report
keep <- c("NO_2", "PM10", "CO", "SO_2", "O_3")
data <- raw %>% filter(pollutant %in% keep)

# 5. Join station metadata
data <- data %>%
  left_join(stations, by = c("station" = "id"))

# 6. Sanity check
cat("Rows:", nrow(data), "\n")
cat("Years:", paste(range(data$year), collapse = "-"), "\n")
cat("Stations:", n_distinct(data$station), "\n")
cat("Pollutants:", paste(unique(data$pollutant), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# 7. Cache to RDS so we don't re-read 480 MB every time
saveRDS(data, "data_clean.rds")
```
# Visualisation 1 — Multi-line Trend (% change vs 2001)

```{r}
# Annual mean concentration per pollutant (city-wide average)
yearly_mean <- data %>%
  group_by(year, pollutant) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Compute the 2001 baseline for each pollutant
baseline_2001 <- yearly_mean %>%
  filter(year == 2001) %>%
  select(pollutant, baseline = mean_value)

# Percentage change relative to 2001
trend_pct <- yearly_mean %>%
  inner_join(baseline_2001, by = "pollutant") %>%
  mutate(pct_change = (mean_value - baseline) / baseline * 100)

# Tidy pollutant labels
trend_pct$pollutant <- recode(trend_pct$pollutant,
                              "NO_2" = "NO2",
                              "SO_2" = "SO2",
                              "O_3"  = "O3")

# Build the plot
p1 <- ggplot(trend_pct, aes(x = year, y = pct_change, colour = pollutant)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2001, 2018, 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    title    = "Annual mean pollutant concentrations, % change vs 2001",
    subtitle = "Madrid, 2001-2018 (city-wide average across monitoring stations)",
    x        = "Year",
    y        = "Change vs 2001 baseline",
    colour   = "Pollutant"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Save the figure
ggsave("figures/01_trend_pct_change.png",
       plot = p1, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

p1
```
# Visualisation 2 — Geographic Bubble Map (2018)

```{r}
# Aggregate 2018 mean per station for NO_2 and PM10
station_2018 <- data %>%
  filter(year == 2018, pollutant %in% c("NO_2", "PM10")) %>%
  group_by(station, pollutant, name, lon, lat) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Drop stations with no coordinates and pivot to wide format
station_wide <- station_2018 %>%
  filter(!is.na(lon)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = pollutant, values_from = mean_value) %>%
  filter(!is.na(NO_2), !is.na(PM10))

cat("Stations on map:", nrow(station_wide), "\n")

# Plot bubbles: size = NO2, colour = PM10
p2 <- ggplot(station_wide, aes(x = lon, y = lat)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = NO_2, colour = PM10), alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name  = "Mean NO2\n(ug/m3)",
    range = c(3, 14)
  ) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(
    name   = "Mean PM10\n(ug/m3)",
    option = "plasma"
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = name),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 25,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  labs(
    title    = "Spatial distribution of NO2 and PM10 across Madrid (2018)",
    subtitle = "Bubble size encodes NO2; colour encodes PM10",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

ggsave("figures/02_bubble_map_2018.png",
       plot = p2, width = 11, height = 7.5, dpi = 300)

p2
```

# Visualisation 3 — Diverging Bar Chart (NO2 change 2008 to 2018)

```{r viz3-diverging}
# Per-station mean NO2 in 2008 and 2018
station_change <- data %>%
  filter(pollutant == "NO_2", year %in% c(2008, 2018)) %>%
  group_by(station, name, year) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = mean_value, names_prefix = "y") %>%
  filter(!is.na(y2008), !is.na(y2018), !is.na(name)) %>%
  mutate(
    change    = y2018 - y2008,
    direction = ifelse(change > 0, "Worsened", "Improved")
  ) %>%
  arrange(change) %>%
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = name))

cat("Stations with NO2 in both 2008 and 2018:", nrow(station_change), "\n")

# Plot
p3 <- ggplot(station_change, aes(x = change, y = name)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = direction), width = 0.75) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = filter(station_change, change >= 0),
            aes(label = sprintf("2018: %.0f", y2018)),
            hjust = -0.15, size = 3, colour = "grey20") +
  geom_text(data = filter(station_change, change < 0),
            aes(label = sprintf("2018: %.0f", y2018)),
            hjust = 1.15, size = 3, colour = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Improved" = "#2c7fb8", "Worsened" = "#d7301f"),
    name   = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Change in mean NO2 per station, 2008 to 2018",
    subtitle = "Labels show absolute 2018 level (ug/m3). EU annual limit = 40 ug/m3.",
    x = "Change in mean NO2 (ug/m3)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  expand_limits(x = c(min(station_change$change) - 8,
                      max(station_change$change) + 12)) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("figures/03_diverging_change.png",
       plot = p3, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)

p3
```

# Visualisation 4 — Seasonal Heatmap (NO2 month × year)

```{r viz4-heatmap}
# Mean monthly NO2 across all monitoring stations
heatmap_data <- data %>%
  filter(pollutant == "NO_2") %>%
  group_by(year, month) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(month_label = factor(month.abb[month], levels = rev(month.abb)))

# Plot
p4 <- ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = year, y = month_label, fill = mean_value)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name    = "Mean NO2\n(ug/m3)",
    option  = "viridis"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2001, 2018, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Monthly mean NO2 in Madrid, 2001-2018",
    subtitle = "Colour encodes mean NO2 (viridis palette, colour-blind safe)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Month"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid  = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

ggsave("figures/04_seasonal_heatmap.png",
       plot = p4, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

# Visualisation 5 — Slope Graph (Pollutant Profile 2001 vs 2018)

```{r viz5-slope}
# Mean per pollutant in 2001 and 2018
slope_data <- data %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2001, 2018)) %>%
  group_by(year, pollutant) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Lookup of direction (improved vs worsened)
direction_lookup <- slope_data %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = mean_value, names_prefix = "y") %>%
  mutate(direction = ifelse(y2018 > y2001, "Worsened", "Improved")) %>%
  select(pollutant, direction)

# Percentage of 2001 baseline + tidy labels
slope_pct <- slope_data %>%
  group_by(pollutant) %>%
  mutate(pct = mean_value / mean_value[year == 2001] * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(direction_lookup, by = "pollutant") %>%
  mutate(pollutant = recode(pollutant,
                            "NO_2" = "NO2",
                            "SO_2" = "SO2",
                            "O_3"  = "O3"))
# Slope graph
p5 <- ggplot(slope_pct,
             aes(x = factor(year), y = pct, group = pollutant, colour = direction)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = filter(slope_pct, year == 2018),
    aes(label = paste0(pollutant, ": ", round(pct), "%")),
    nudge_x        = 0.15,
    hjust          = 0,
    size           = 3.8,
    fontface       = "bold",
    direction      = "y",
    segment.colour = "grey70",
    segment.size   = 0.3,
    box.padding    = 0.4,
    show.legend    = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate("text",
           x = 1, y = 108,
           label = "2001 baseline (100%)",
           colour = "grey30",
           size = 3.3,
           fontface = "italic",
           hjust = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("Improved" = "#2c7fb8", "Worsened" = "#d7301f"),
    name   = NULL
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  expand_limits(x = c(0.4, 2.6)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Pollutant profile: 2001 versus 2018",
    subtitle = "Each line shows mean concentration as a percentage of the 2001 baseline",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percentage of 2001 baseline"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

ggsave("figures/05_slope_graph.png",
       plot = p5, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

p5
```

# Visualisation 6 — Small Multiples per Pollutant (GH1)

```{r viz6-small-multiples}
# Annual mean per pollutant (city-wide)
sm_data <- data %>%
  filter(pollutant %in% c("NO_2", "PM10", "SO_2", "CO", "O_3")) %>%
  group_by(year, pollutant) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pollutant = recode(pollutant,
                            "NO_2" = "NO2",
                            "SO_2" = "SO2",
                            "O_3"  = "O3"),
         pollutant = factor(pollutant,
                            levels = c("NO2", "PM10", "SO2", "CO", "O3")))

# Small multiples plot
p6 <- ggplot(sm_data, aes(x = year, y = mean_value)) +
  geom_area(fill = "#a6cee3", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, colour = "#1f78b4") +
  geom_point(size = 1.6, colour = "#1f78b4") +
  facet_wrap(~ pollutant, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2001, 2018, 4)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Annual mean concentration per pollutant, 2001-2018",
    subtitle = "Each panel uses its own y-axis range, so each trend can be read clearly",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean annual concentration (ug/m3, except CO in mg/m3)"
  ) +
  theme(strip.text     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        panel.spacing  = unit(1, "lines"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

ggsave("figures/06_small_multiples.png",
       plot = p6, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

# Visualisation 7 — Parallel Coordinates per Station (GH2)

```{r viz7-parallel}
# 2018 mean per station across three pollutants
station_pc <- data %>%
  filter(year == 2018, pollutant %in% c("NO_2", "PM10", "O_3")) %>%
  group_by(station, name, pollutant) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!is.na(name))

# Keep only stations that measured all three pollutants
station_wide <- station_pc %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = pollutant, values_from = mean_value) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.))

cat("Stations with all 3 pollutants in 2018:", nrow(station_wide), "\n")

# Back to long format and normalise each pollutant to [0, 1]
station_long <- station_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(c(NO_2, PM10, O_3),
               names_to = "pollutant", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(pollutant = recode(pollutant,
                            "NO_2" = "NO2",
                            "O_3"  = "O3"),
         pollutant = factor(pollutant, levels = c("NO2", "PM10", "O3"))) %>%
  group_by(pollutant) %>%
  mutate(norm = (value - min(value)) / (max(value) - min(value))) %>%
  ungroup()

# Highlight four anchor stations
highlight <- c("Plaza Castilla", "Casa de Campo",
               "Pza. Fernández Ladreda", "Escuelas Aguirre")

station_long <- station_long %>%
  mutate(highlighted = ifelse(name %in% highlight, name, "Other"))

# Plot
p7 <- ggplot(station_long, aes(x = pollutant, y = norm, group = name)) +
  geom_line(data = filter(station_long, highlighted == "Other"),
            colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(data = filter(station_long, highlighted != "Other"),
            aes(colour = highlighted), linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_point(data = filter(station_long, highlighted != "Other"),
             aes(colour = highlighted), size = 2.8) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Highlighted stations") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Parallel coordinates: monitoring station profiles in 2018",
    subtitle = "Each line is one station; values normalised to [0, 1] per pollutant axis",
    x = "Pollutant",
    y = "Normalised value (0 = city minimum, 1 = city maximum)"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position  = "right",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

ggsave("figures/07_parallel_coords.png",
       plot = p7, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 300)

p7
```

# Visualisation 8 — Radar Chart (Pollutant Profile 2001 vs 2018)
```{r viz8-radar}
library(fmsb)

# Mean per pollutant in 2001 and 2018, expressed as % of 2001 baseline
radar_data <- data %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2001, 2018),
         pollutant %in% c("NO_2", "PM10", "SO_2", "CO", "O_3")) %>%
  group_by(year, pollutant) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(pollutant) %>%
  mutate(pct = mean_value / mean_value[year == 2001] * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(pollutant = recode(pollutant,
                            "NO_2" = "NO2",
                            "SO_2" = "SO2",
                            "O_3"  = "O3"))

# Pivot to wide form so each row is one year, columns are pollutants
radar_wide <- radar_data %>%
  select(year, pollutant, pct) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = pollutant, values_from = pct) %>%
  select(year, NO2, PM10, O3, SO2, CO)

# fmsb requires the first two rows to be axis maximum and minimum
radar_mat <- rbind(
  rep(160, 5),
  rep(0,   5),
  as.data.frame(radar_wide[, -1])
)
rownames(radar_mat) <- c("max", "min", "2001", "2018")

# Save to PNG (fmsb is base graphics, not ggplot)
png("figures/08_radar.png", width = 8, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300)
par(mar = c(3, 2, 4, 2))
radarchart(
  radar_mat,
  axistype    = 1,
  pcol        = c("#1f78b4", "#33a02c"),
  pfcol       = c(adjustcolor("#1f78b4", 0.25),
                  adjustcolor("#33a02c", 0.25)),
  plwd        = 2.5,
  plty        = 1,
  cglcol      = "grey80",
  cglty       = 1,
  cglwd       = 0.8,
  axislabcol  = "grey50",
  caxislabels = c("0%", "40%", "80%", "120%", "160%"),
  vlcex       = 1.1,
  title       = "Pollutant profile: 2001 vs 2018 (radar view)"
)
legend("bottom",
       legend = c("2001", "2018"),
       col    = c("#1f78b4", "#33a02c"),
       lwd    = 2,
       bty    = "n",
       horiz  = TRUE,
       cex    = 1)
dev.off()

# Display the saved PNG inline in the report
knitr::include_graphics("figures/08_radar.png")
```



# Visualisation 9 — Comprehensive Dashboard
```{r viz9-dashboard, fig.width=16, fig.height=22}
library(patchwork)
library(png)
library(grid)

# The radar chart (Visualisation 8) was rendered with fmsb directly to PNG,
# so we read it back in and wrap it as a ggplot-compatible panel.
radar_img <- readPNG("figures/08_radar.png")
p8_panel <- ggplot() +
  annotation_custom(rasterGrob(radar_img, interpolate = TRUE)) +
  theme_void()

# Compose the dashboard (4 rows by 2 columns)
dashboard <- (p1 | p5) /
             (p6 | p8_panel) /
             (p2 | p7) /
             (p3 | p4) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Madrid Air Quality 2001-2018 - Comprehensive Dashboard",
    subtitle = "Group 6 - VDS2526 Implementation Report",
    theme    = theme(plot.title    = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
                     plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, colour = "grey40"))
  )

ggsave("figures/09_dashboard_composite.png",
       plot  = dashboard,
       width = 16, height = 22, dpi = 150)

dashboard
```
